blurb: Guests participate in sound healing ceremonies, breathwork classes, yoga sessions, and meditation events. The experiences include immersive sound baths with crystal bowls and gongs, breathwork to improve respiratory and emotional health, and yoga designed for fertility support. Classes are offered both in-studio and online, with some events featuring remote participation from instructors.
